input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (ventures brief)
errors: Two hand-written calendar strings (test fixture, example generator) had an unbalanced parenthesis; the engine fell back to a 24-hour calendar with only a warning. Fixed the strings, made the CLI and page print calendar warnings, added a test.
The critical path test's what-if re-run mutated shared project state (forecast finish moved by 600 days in the report). Fixed by copying project state per schedule run.
Two hand-arithmetic test expectations were wrong (float of 16 h should be 8 h); the engine was right.

doc_friction.issue: Start here pointed at ids-model-check, whose buildable items are ifcXML/eval niches after 24 records in 2 days; its remaining next: items need outside inputs. Its buildable note should be pruned by the next ids-model-check run.

Running a downloaded third-party library (PyP6Xer, LGPL) as a cross-check reference was refused by the auto-mode classifier; no doc says independent cross-checks against third-party code need a different route (e.g. pip install from pypi).

deviations.why: Took a new venture instead of the allocator's Start here row (ids-model-check): its remaining work is ifcXML eval niches or needs outside inputs, the brief asks to start new ventures too, and the owner's top direction is construction.
deviations.did: Built xer-schedule-check (P6 XER reader, P6-faithful CPM engine, DCMA 14-point) and added it to portfolio/flagships.yaml so later runs deepen it.

notes: Local checks: run_venture_tests.py xer-schedule-check ok (20 tests); optout-persistence ok after sync_tree_counts.py; check_posts ok; validate.py ok; Playwright smoke (example, 30 MB CCA in 1.9 s, mobile no overflow, no console errors). venture-preflight run in background, result in PR. Eval data (six public XER files) not committed: licences unclear.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
